reviews.title: Wonderful workouts
reviews.text: I have been using down dog for 2 years now. The best part is with my teacher status it is free!  Each workout is different and I can choose duration of time, music choice, area to workout, and the voice of my trainer. There are several n different down dog apps, they’re all amazing! I especially love the hitt, barre, and yoga. This has helped stretch my sciatica and back i love the convenience. I can use this on vacation, at work, or home. Amazing! And it’s free for teachers!!

reviews.title: Enjoyable
reviews.text:
I have enjoyed the Down Dog Suite for some years now. I rotate between Yoga, Pilates & Barre. I enjoy that they are highly configurable, and even with the settings the same, the workout varies from day to day. Occasionally I even use the HIIT app.

Thank you for these apps.

reviews.title: Best At Home Barre
reviews.text: Title says it all~best at home barre that I’ve ever done. I love that you can custom pick what areas you’d like to work on. I feel like a real ballerina when I’m done(😅😂)&my other workouts don’t really hit my calves like this barre does-so that gets me every time, in a good way! I don’t know what I’d do without all of Down Dog App’s different apps. I use them all the time(pretty much daily). Today I did a core only class after a bike ride-which was perfect!!! 😍 Thx DDApp we love you guys so much. If you’re hesitant to download the app.. try the free trial like I did. I knew I would keep paying for it indefinitely- that was 6 years ago and I’m still going strong. 💪🏽

reviews.title: The reviewers are right.
reviews.text: LOVE LOVE LOVE the yoga app, have used it for years but I really hope they give this app more attention and fix it. The instructions are incredibly vague and it has no toggle for beginners and doesn’t seem to hit much of the upper body at all. Maybe it’s the few ones I tried but they were just not for me. What makes the down dog yoga app so special is a bit lacking here. Like another reviewer said, you can do a few minutes and it’ll definitely get you moving but beyond a 10 minute workout I can’t really bear it.

reviews.title: So much variety
reviews.text: I have been using this app for over four years now. I love everything about it. Over the years they have updated it. I’ve used the yoga app the most. So much variety in length, areas to focus on, level of ability, how long to hold poses for, to various genres of music (which you can save into your own playlists on Spotify and Apple Music). You can even favorite practices to come back to them. I use the meditation app for sleep. It unwinds me faster than anything else. I generally am asleep halfway through the practice. The Barre app is intense and I feel it working quickly. All the other apps are incredible too- for reasons listed above. Highly recommend!!

reviews.text: The exercises themselves are great - challenging and rewarding. Would love more personalization like the other DownDog apps. Would love a warm up and cool down option and level ratings (eg beginner, intermediate, expert). Will keep using but not as much as the other DownDog apps.

reviews.title: Inadequate at every level
reviews.text: Unlike the HIIT app from the same developer, this one is really lacking. There’s no customization for levels, there’s no warm up, the narration provides minimal explanation of what the model is doing, there’s no transition between exercises. While every app poses risks, in the sense that it cannot be a substitute for in-person instruction on form, this one feels particularly like a set up for injury given these gaps.

reviews.title: Needs more variation and customization
reviews.text: Compared to DownDog Yoga app the Barre app is trash. It needs more variety, choices, and clearer instructions. I’d also like to specify if I want more or less standing vs mat work. Just about every class I’ve generated has been the same: half the time standing sequence and then half down on all fours. I have injuries that make this very painful. I wanted to love this app but it just needs a lot of work.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: It’s awesome that they offer free services for students, as I currently was very broke. Now I’m completely hooked! I never wrote reviews for apps, but if this review could help anyone who was in a similar situation as I was in this is the app to get! The app's diverse workout options  make it a solid choice for anyone serious about fitness. Definitely worth the download for a well-rounded workout experience.

reviews.title: Painful
reviews.text: I wish they’d update Barre like they do Yoga. The exercises are effective, but the algorithm isn’t very good. You’ll completely, inhumanly burn out a muscle group on one side, then immediately switch to the other side and there’s never any time to shake it out or rest. It HURTS. Plus, this was recorded years ago and they’ve never added any new material or options they way they do for Yoga. So, plus 3 stars because it’s a good workout, but minus 2 stars because it’s old and impossible to complete it without taking breaks.

reviews.title: Need more modifications
reviews.text: Their other apps are great but this one has very little you can modify, some things I would love: a difficulty level setting (easy vs hard), standing only option, arms with light weights option, and aerobic boost.

reviews.title: Best app yet
reviews.text: I’ve tried so many of these apps and they’ve all let me down. This one has wonderful instructions from the voice over and the person doing the exercises isn’t the one talking or making side comments.  I love the voice instruction. It’s just like being in a class which I’m no longer able to join because of my work schedule.  Great app. Very pleased.

reviews.title: Favorite workout app by far
reviews.text: I love this app so much. There aren’t any obnoxious overly peppy people cheering you on, lol… the narrator is super soothing. You select your workout time and target areas and it creates a workout for you with no fluff, i.e., no intros, no chatting, just gets right to it. And you can save favorite workouts. I’m a new mom who enjoyed barre classes before I was pregnant, and this makes that part of my life feel accessible again. The prenatal app from this same developer was also great.

reviews.title: Needs upper body focus
reviews.text: This app is an all around great app when it comes to variation and customization but one area I feel it’s lacking is having the option for upper body focus. Even in the full body focus there’s minimal upper body exercises and variation. Also the transitions in between work outs could be a little smoother.
